trial_court: Family Court, Bombay, M.J. Petition No. 799 of 1989 and Petition No. 500 of 1989
case_name: Subash Popatlal Shah vs Smt. Lata Subhash Shah
facts_of_case: The respondent-wife filed for dissolution of marriage under Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 and separate maintenance for herself and son Anand under Section 125 of the Criminal Procedure Code. The trial court passed a decree on June 28, 1991.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to set aside a finding of fact to show that the finding is unreasonable.
legal_principles.held: Not even a suggestion was made to him in the cross-examination that the appellant was not his father.
cited_cases: Subash Popatlal Shah vs Smt. Lata Subhash Shah, (1993)

legal_principles.principle: The court will not accept evidence that is a figment of imagination and totally false.
legal_principles.held: We are, therefore, more than satisfied that his evidence was a figment of imagination and totally false.
cited_cases: Subash Popatlal Shah vs Smt. Lata Subhash Shah, (1993)

outcome.final_order: The appeals are being disposed by this common judgment as they arise from the same impugned judgment and decree passed by the learned Principal Judge of the Family Court, Bombay.
